# Upstream AF 3.6 — held camera procedure and log retrieval

**Camera capture/shutdown failed; further 3.6 trials are held.**
The owner reports shutter-press freeze and shutdown nonresponse. A read-only
backup and log review followed. See the [failure record](evidence/upstream-36-camera-failure-2026-10-15.md).
The steps below preserve the requested historical procedure; they are not a
request to repeat it. Backup/recovery remain coordinated separately.
See the [live installation record](evidence/upstream-36-upload-2026-10-15.md).
No camera action is requested by this document alone.
The [candidate](../firmware/candidates/3.6.0/README.md) and
[offline validation](evidence/upstream-36-handoff-2026-10-15.md) do not establish
A7C II stability. The prior 3.2 transaction passed its normal guarded verification
after owner-confirmed physical reconnect. The owner then separately authorized
3.6 installation; its own physical reconnect and strict verification also passed.
Never delete/edit the pending journal or reconnect marker to bypass it.

## Separate upload and byte verification

After explicit authorization, confirm the adapter is on the USB cap, the
TECHART updater is closed and the saved original profile is the unedited
Contax Zeiss 50mm f/1.4. App 0.19/build 23 exposes **USB tools → Install Upstream AF 3.6.0**. Its CLI equivalent, for that future coordinated operation:

```sh
dist/ea9ctl apply-handoff-upstream contax-zeiss-50-f1-4 --idle
# Stop. Owner must physically unplug/reconnect and confirm the new connection.
# Keep the adapter off the camera until strict verification has passed.
dist/ea9ctl verify --idle
```

The fresh same-unit two-pass backup, durable journal and protected data checks
remain mandatory. START arms the connection: no CHECK/READ/control/end marker or
retry is sent afterward on that connection. An acknowledgement is not byte
verification. Require the complete 20,480-byte pristine image, including all
blank log pages, and existing protected metadata/flash/auxiliary checks. The
six established loader scratch bytes remain the sole metadata exception.
Record an independent offline comparison of the verification backup before
camera use. A decoder prefix match cannot substitute for this gate.

## One initial loaded-lens cycle

After the strict gate succeeds, coordinate one cycle before AF-S. With the
A7C II off and camera USB disconnected, mount the LM-EA9, C/Y-to-M converter and
50mm lens. Set the physical focus ring to infinity and iris to f/1.4. Select
still-photo A, EV0, Auto ISO, **Manual Focus separately in Focus → AF/MF → Focus
Mode**, and Pre-AF Off where available. Record actual settings; unknown settings
stay unknown. The A exposure dial alone does not select MF.

1. Switch on without shutter/AF-ON. Note preview updating/brightness, aperture
   display (nominal f/1.4), motor movement/sound and whether it stops.
2. If responsive and quiet, wait ten seconds after movement stops. If the preview
   freezes or aperture stays `--`, skip photo/AF and switch off once.
3. Only if preview, aperture and motion are normal and MF is confirmed, take one
   photograph. Record whether it saves and its exposure; preserve its local path
   for optional EXIF inspection. Switch off once and leave it off.

For a freeze, shutdown nonresponse, grinding, repeated stop impacts or abnormal
continuous drive for about two seconds, stop: switch off; remove the battery if
unresponsive or motion continues; do not retry or restart for missing details.
Report the exact trigger (startup/half/full press), saved-photo status and
shutdown behavior. No further camera cycle or AF-S is needed before log review.

This candidate intentionally starts no new parking drive on shutdown. Motor
silence is not proof of AF failure or physical infinity. Physical iris remains
manual and Unknown to the adapter; the nominal f-number cannot track ring changes.
Do not introduce exposure offsets based only on a mismatched f-number report.

## Read-only logs and next AF-S decision

With the camera off/unpowered and motor stopped, return to the USB cap and
physically reconnect, updater closed. Confirm that state before a new read-only
native backup. Use new private paths:

```sh
dist/ea9ctl backup /new/after-36.ea9backup --idle
python3 scripts/decode-startup-diagnostics.py /new/after-36.ea9backup --output /new/after-36.json
```

Trace v2 persists only on terminal shutdown after UART disable, or terminal
fail-stop. The ten-second idle does **not** flush 3.6. Battery removal, full/torn
storage or an unentered terminal path can leave blank/incomplete logs. First 24
and latest 24 RAM retention is bounded; a summary reports planned events, while
the decoder reports how many survived. A shutdown marker proves reaching that
software point, not electrical power removal or a successful next boot.

Decoder identity checks require the exact version, complete published image and manifest
pins, immutable prefix, and per-page structure/CRC; a native manifest also needs
two flash/auxiliary reads and the full flash hash. It explicitly does not verify
installation. Page `state: valid` means structure/CRC only; `recordTrust` and cohort checks separately identify inconsistent, partial or unassociated evidence. CRC is not authentication. Camera-written diagnostic pages mean ordinary `inspect` no longer
recognizes a pristine image; use `backup` plus the decoder after camera use.
Compare all outside-log flash and auxiliary data separately. Do not erase/reset
logs; raw unit dumps and actual camera exchanges stay private.

Only after a successful preview/MF-capture/idle/shutdown cycle and log review,
plan a separate bounded AF-S comparison with actual AF-S and Pre-AF Off settings,
a bright stationary target, infinity focus-ring position and physical f/1.4.
Record lock/release, hunting, motion and saved-photo sharpness. Neither a green
indicator nor host tests qualify optical accuracy. AF-C/video, zoom changes,
other lenses and factory parity remain later acceptance work.

# Post-3.5 startup handoff composition

[Candidate 3.6](../../candidates/3.6.0/README.md) accepts the scoped EIC setup/start
proposal, two release-invisible RAM snapshot omissions and BCD version 0x36.
The rejected full-PRIMASK proposal remains only in the audit workbench. Root
owns integration; scripts here never access hardware.

The builder requires exact pinned 3.5 materialization at
`artifacts/private/absolute35a`. If absent, reproduce the
[3.5 prerequisites](../next35/README.md) first:

```sh
python3 scripts/build-upstream-absolute.py --output artifacts/private/absolute35a
```

Then choose fresh private output paths under existing parents:

```sh
python3 scripts/build-upstream-handoff.py --output artifacts/private/recheck36
python3 scripts/test-upstream-handoff.py --build artifacts/private/recheck36 --output artifacts/private/recheck36-tests
scripts/swift-local.sh test
scripts/build-macos-app.sh
```

`accepted-lanes.json` pins the exact applicators and supporting source tests.
The production delta changes only EIC C/header and protocol C/version header.
The host shim gains a separate no-op hardware API for tests; its hash is bound
in the manifest and it is never linked into the ARM image. Flags, compiler,
controller and drivers remain unchanged. The builder checks initialized-data
load extent, the 256-byte minimum margin, vectors, RAM/stack limits and blank
diagnostic pages. A published 3.6 image must reproduce exactly.

`replay.py` reuses pinned prior regression templates in private copies rather
than duplicating their fixtures per release. Explicit transformations retain
the original fixture locations, bind the new version/image/manifest and use
the new hardware mock ABI only for proposal sources. Test cases and expected
outcomes are unchanged; frozen controls retain their old sources and mocks.
Each replay records both template and transformed-runner hashes. Exact final
startup tests execute actual UART/EIC source through the independent lane 28
harness. Source/compiled identities are checked before and after execution.

The master also runs retained capture/shutdown/home/query/numeric/target/time
checks, decoder boundaries and the compiled ARM writer. Its compiled stack/
handoff audit keeps every reviewed callback, library, vector and ordering guard.
Fresh ELF/map path strings may differ: `stack-reproduction.json` permits only
those container pins to be rebound after exact image/raw/manifest/source and
normalized disassembly/symbol/program-header equality. No compiled ordering
or physical-entry caveat is relaxed.

Native Swift tests, signed packaging and isolated prepare-only commands are
separate checks. Do not launch the app during offline work: normal refresh

# Upstream C hardening workbench

The current follow-up composition is the separately frozen [3.6 offline candidate](../candidates/3.6.0/README.md).
See its [build and test workbench](next36/README.md) and
[evidence](../../docs/evidence/upstream-36-handoff-2026-10-15.md).
It is **not installed or camera-qualified** and does not change the pending uploaded 3.2.
The sections below preserve the original eleven-lane 3.3 composition and commands.
[Unified evidence](../../docs/evidence/upstream-33-hardening-2026-10-15.md),
[campaign](../../docs/audits/astra-hardening-campaign-2026-10-15.md) and
[eight-hour ledger](../../docs/firmware-hardening-2026-10-15.md) track scope and
acceptance. Published images and their pins remain immutable.

`src/em_frame.c/.h` validates the complete E-mount frame before dispatch:
start, little-endian 16-bit length, minimum nine bytes, available bytes,
terminator and additive checksum. A successful view excludes the CS-window
tail; a failed view is cleared. Nonzero tails are allowed. The module has no
device API, heap, global state, class interpretation or motor instruction.
The caller must supply a stable receive window. This is **not** an interrupt
ownership or message-semantic validator.

The runner first pins every materialized 3.2 C/header input to its build
manifest and checks the committed image. It then builds a temporary `emount.c`
overlay that calls this gate before any dispatch and uses the validated length
for known field guards and request snapshots. It retains the original window
length for diagnostics. Frozen 3.2 and the overlay run the same probes with
ASan/UBSan. Deliberately bad/truncated traffic must not arm handshake readiness
or publish a Move; short padded messages must not read footer/tail operands.
Valid init/Move and nonzero-padding controls must still work. The original
source tree, candidates and app resources are never rewritten by this runner.

Reproduce from the repo root, using a new output path under an existing parent:

```sh
# Only if the ignored, pinned 3.2 build inputs are absent:
python3 scripts/build-upstream-diagnostic.py
python3 scripts/test-upstream-frame-admission.py --output /new/frame-admission-check
```

The corpus fixture is regenerated from
`references/analysis/entropy512-frames.jsonl`, never from private camera logs.
The 3,456 valid windows include both directions. Corpus replay validates the
frame module; fifteen separate fixtures execute the actual C dispatcher under
scripted CS and immediate TX. Neither proves A7C II compatibility, asynchronous
peripheral timing or optical performance. A future release needs a separate
version, complete build/host regression gates and owner-coordinated hardware
acceptance. Preserve 3.2 for the already requested diagnostic cycle.


## Complete 3.3 composition

`accepted-lanes.json` pins the source/test/applicator inputs. The builder applies
frame admission and explicit transmit success, then lanes 02/01/03/05/06/07/08/10/09.
Research-only04 supplies original-instruction contracts;11 independently reviews
the Mac host. Lane06 owns the motor overlay. New pure ownership/shutdown/frame
modules remain separate C units; homing/transport/driver changes apply to staged
upstream sources. The complete patch includes added modules.

Use the pinned dependencies and materialized 3.2 build described by the
[diagnostic workbench](../upstream-diagnostic/README.md). Choose fresh paths under
existing writable parents:

```sh
python3 scripts/build-upstream-hardened.py --output firmware/upstream-hardening/build/reproduce-33
python3 scripts/test-upstream-hardened.py --build firmware/upstream-hardening/build/reproduce-33 --output artifacts/private/reproduce-33-tests
python3 firmware/upstream-hardening/lanes/09-release/run.py --lane10 --output artifacts/private/reproduce-33-size
python3 firmware/upstream-hardening/lanes/09-release/test.py --build artifacts/private/reproduce-33-size
scripts/swift-local.sh test
scripts/build-macos-app.sh
```

The builder requires at least 256 bytes before diagnostics, validates code plus
initialized data and RAM boundaries, records per-unit optimization/stack estimates,
pads only within the 20 KiB application and refuses an image differing from frozen 3.3.
It never publishes, packages, opens a device or installs firmware. Two fresh root
builds produce identical image/manifest/patch. Test scripts operate only on local
source, simulated peripherals, published bytes and synthetic dumps. Individual
lane reports provide their negative controls and complete finite test commands.

`test-upstream-hardened.py` binds exact staged source/image to the published
candidate and bundled resource, then executes final commit/capture/diagnostic
probes, the compiled ARM page writer and actual published 3.2/3.3 decoder pins.
The REA virtual environment supplies Unicorn. This is separate from strict
native installation verification; mutable diagnostic tails never gain an upload
verification exception. Mac preparation uses a new explicit 3.3 command; old CLI
meanings are preserved. A future executable change needs another version/digest.

The release removes unused legacy telemetry and some trace-only sensor reads.
That changes incidental cadence, so exact host outputs are not physical timing
proof. The original C controller remains; factory reconstruction and A7C II
capture/exposure/focus behavior remain unqualified. Follow the
[separately coordinated test procedure](../../docs/upstream-hardening-test.md).
